seo.title: Fishing Community Empowerment Academy | Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: Kuruwitu's two decade conservation record turned into a fellowship, training fishing community leaders, women and youth to drive sustainable fisheries management.

hero.title: Fishing Community Empowerment Academy
hero.text: Transforming fisheries management through community leadership.

pullQuoteIntro.text: "Healthy fisheries depend on strong, empowered communities, not short term, externally driven projects."
pullQuoteIntro.text2: The Academy places communities at the centre of decision making, equipping them with the knowledge, practical skills and long term support to manage their own marine resources and build resilient coastal livelihoods.

skillsGrid.heading: Eight Skills, Taught Through Experience
skillsGrid.text: Community leaders, women, youth and other underrepresented groups train through experiential learning, practical field work and long term mentoring, then return home to share what they have learned.

livingClassroom.heading: Twenty Years of Proof, in One Place
livingClassroom.text: At the heart of the Academy is the Kuruwitu Co-Managed Area, Oceans Alive's internationally recognised Living Classroom, where participants learn directly from more than two decades of successful community-led marine conservation.
livingClassroom.text2: Here they see how healthy ecosystems, strong governance, sustainable fisheries, women's empowerment, scientific monitoring and sustainable finance work together, then take those lessons home as practical training materials and toolkits that can be adapted by fishing communities across Kenya, the Western Indian Ocean and beyond.

participantToCustodianJourney.heading: From Participant to Custodian
participantToCustodianJourney.text2: Joins a conservation project led by others, learning by watching and doing.
participantToCustodianJourney.text4: Takes on governance, monitoring and mentoring roles within their own BMU.
participantToCustodianJourney.text6: Owns and sustains a self-reliant, financially independent Co-Managed Marine Area.
participantToCustodianJourney.text7: By investing in people, leadership and long term capacity, Oceans Alive is helping communities move from being participants in conservation projects to becoming the leaders, innovators and custodians of their own marine resources.

callToAction.heading: Help Build the Next Generation of Ocean Leaders
callToAction.text: Your support trains community leaders who can strengthen fisheries governance and build self-reliant marine areas across the coast.
